name: se.curity.identityserver.haapi.android.ui.widget.previewer.host.HaapiUIPreviewerHostActivity
description: The Curity Identity Server HAAPI UI.Widget SDK's debug previewer opens this Activity to display a sample sign-in screen supplied by a developer. It is a development preview screen, not part of normal sign-in.
disableEffect: The debug sign-in preview cannot be opened; normal Curity sign-in remains available.
